evals.name: New team member full onboarding flow
evals.prompt: I just joined the Panviva team and my manager told me to get SkillForge set up. I have no idea what that means or where to start. Can you walk me through it?
evals.expected_output: Skill walks through all onboarding steps in order, starting with Okta group admin access request, pausing for user confirmation at each step, ending with skillforge init and project-specific setup after asking which project to initialize

evals.name: Handle 401 Unauthorized error during skillforge init
evals.prompt: I ran skillforge init panviva-core and got a 401 Unauthorized error. What is wrong?
evals.expected_output: Skill jumps to error diagnosis, identifies api_key or server_url misconfiguration, has user run skillforge config get server_url and skillforge config get api_key, re-runs config steps if either is missing or wrong

evals.name: CLI not found on Windows after pip install
evals.prompt: I ran pip install git+https://github.com/panviva/pv-ai-skillforge.git and it succeeded, but skillforge --version says command not found on Windows
evals.expected_output: Skill recognises Windows PATH/Python-version mismatch, suggests py -m skillforge as fallback, flags known ModuleNotFoundError: No module named src failure mode as alternate possibility
